name: Coley Walsh

tenures.source: the Fury results script, 8 September 2002 (promotions/ucwf/archive/fury-2002-09-08.html); the Immortality 2002 results script (promotions/ucwf/archive/immortality-2002.html)
tenures.note: Billed as having “gone AWOL” from his own stable in Mumrat's own words; runs in on Mumrat's ring promo at Fury 2002-09-08 and brawls with him. Returns mid-match during Immortality's own Extreme/World Hell in a Cell, spears Mumrat and slams him through the cage roof, then joins Brax, The Fox and a newly unmasked Solidus in revealing the stable Unforeseen Vengeance.

caption: Returned mid-match at Immortality 2002 to spear Mumrat through the cage roof and reveal the stable Unforeseen Vengeance.

name: Solidus

tenures.source: the Immortality 2002 results script (promotions/ucwf/archive/immortality-2002.html)
tenures.note: A masked man who teams with a returning Fox against Scorpion during Immortality's own Extreme/World Hell in a Cell, then unmasks post-match as Solidus, billed “the man that Brax has trained,” and joins Brax, The Fox and a returning Coley Walsh in forming the stable Unforeseen Vengeance. His only appearance in the surviving record.

caption: Unmasked as Brax's own trainee at Immortality 2002, forming the stable Unforeseen Vengeance.

name: Makayla Royal
